examples.derivation: Changing every sign in Q gives (2-3)x²+(-3-3)x+(5+2)=-x²-6x+7.
Three times Q is 6x³-3x²+9x. Subtracting from x²-5 gives -6x³+4x²-9x-5.
The two distributed products are x⁵-3x³+4x² and 2x³-6x+8. Their sum is x⁵-x³+4x²-6x+8.
Multiplying the identical factors gives x⁴, two -x³ terms, x² terms with coefficients 2+1+2, two -2x terms and constant 4: x⁴-2x³+5x²-4x+4.
